subject: Praxis: premium tenant routing isolation - prioritization request
content:
Message 1
From: Emily Chang <emily@praxisfin.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Praxis Legal <legal@praxisfin.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priority ask — routing isolation for premium tenants (Q3 launch)

Hi Jordan,

We're ramping for a Q3 product launch and need an answer on whether Redwood can deliver tenant-level routing isolation and a higher SLA for our Premium customers. Specifically:
- Model residency pinning (guaranteed residency in us-west)
- Tenant-level cache segmentation / KV prefix isolation
- Audit/log export for requests (near-real-time)
- A guaranteed failover path if a region degrades

This is a gated requirement from our security & compliance team. Can you confirm if this is something you can surface as a prioritization ask to Product & Eng, and if Redwood would sign a 99.9% tokens-serving SLA for those tenants? We can share our compliance profile and legal can start intake if we have a rough timeline.

Attaching: Praxis_requirements_v3.docx (summary)

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chang
Head of Platform Security, Praxis Financial
emily@praxisfin.com

------

Message 2
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chang <emily@praxisfin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority ask — routing isolation for premium tenants (Q3 launch)

Hi Emily — thanks for the specificity. Looping in Laura (Product) and Markus (Engineering) to evaluate feasibility and timelines.

Quick notes from my side: Praxis is a mid-sized deploy with a clear budget and a strong incentive to sign an expanded commitment if we can offer a short-term isolation guarantee. They're asking for a 99.9% serving SLA for Premium tenants and audit hooks. They need a go/no-go within two weeks to drive legal intake and the launch plan.

Proposed immediate ask to product/eng: can we scope a constrained, low-risk "tenant pinning + cache partition" deliverable that buys Praxis their launch safety, and then run a follow-up roadmap item for full dedicated warm pools and advanced audit exports?

I'm attaching a draft SLA proposal (redwood-sla-proposal.pdf) they asked to see.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

------

Message 3
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com (Laura Bennett)
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Emily Chang <emily@praxisfin.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority ask — routing isolation for premium tenants (Q3 launch)

Thanks for the context, Jordan. Emily — appreciate the clear requirements. High level product read: the request touches three subsystems (routing, cache/KV, and telemetry/export). We can approach this as two phases with different risk/cost profiles: 

Option A — Minimum Viable Isolation (6 weeks):
- Tenant pinning: ensure Premium tenant requests route to a constrained pool in us-west.
- Cache partitioning: prefix-based segregation to avoid cross-tenant KV pollution.
- Basic audit export: batched request logs delivered to S3 within ~15 minutes (not streaming).
- Limitations: shared warm pool; autoscaling behavior unchanged; higher per-token cost due to smaller batching opportunities.

Option B — Fully dedicated tenant isolation (12 weeks):
- Dedicated warm pools and autoscaling lanes per tenant group.
- Streamed audit/log exports and expanded trace IDs.
- Orchestrated failover policy with simulated drills.
- Limitations: requires infra changes to autoscaler and billing model updates; higher committed cost.

Questions for Eng: markus — can you confirm resource needs and if we can hit Option A in 6 weeks if we prioritize? Also, if Option A is feasible, we should scope a clean migration path to Option B.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior PM, Product — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Jun 16, 2027 at 09:03 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:

> Short engineering read — thanks for the clear ask.
>
> Option A (6 weeks) is plausible but comes with caveats: we can implement routing pinning and prefix partitioning without touching the autoscaler if we accept degraded batching efficiency. I estimate: 2 SWE (backend) + 1 infra engineer, 6 weeks of focused work (with parallel QA). Risk: increased per-token cost and potential latency variance during traffic spikes.
>
> Option B (12-14 weeks) will require changes to the autoscaler and warm pool reservations; that's a larger effort and a dependency on capacity planning and SRE. For Option B we also need a product decision on committed capacity billing terms.
>
> Related: ENG-1089 (tenant-isolation-spike) — I'll add a breakdown in the ticket and estimate calendar slots.
>
> Markus Klein
> Eng Lead, Runtime
> Redwood Inference

------

Message 4
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chang <emily@praxisfin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, Praxis Legal <legal@praxisfin.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority ask — routing isolation for premium tenants (Q3 launch)

Emily — thanks for the patience. Quick summary and proposed plan: 

1) We can pursue Option A (Minimum Viable Isolation) as a prioritized deliverable. Engineering has scoped a 6-week window with the caveats above — increased per-token cost and limited batching efficiency.

2) Redwood will provide a draft SLA tied to the Premium tenant group (attached: redwood-sla-proposal.pdf). Legal review welcome — Jordan to coordinate intake with Praxis Legal; please let me know the preferred checklist items.

3) Next steps:
- Jordan: kick off a mutual action plan (MAP) and share milestone dates in HubSpot (link included).
- Praxis: confirm willingness to accept Option A (short-term isolation + follow-up roadmap to Option B) and confirm budget/contract cadence.
- Product & Eng: we will schedule a weekly sync and surface ENG-1089 estimates.

Proposed demo/proof-of-concept: week of Jun 28 (we can show tenant pinning and a sample audit export).

Attachments: redwood-sla-proposal.pdf, praxis-prioritization-matrix.xlsx

Thanks all — I will update the HubSpot deal with commitment and calendar invites.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
